title: Senate President Schedules New Vote on Ending 6x1 Work Schedule
seoTitle: New Vote Scheduled for 6x1 Workweek PEC
subtitle: Davi Alcolumbre sets date to review proposal ending the 6x1 work schedule and reducing working hours
excerpt: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre has set next Tuesday (6) for the second vote on the PEC proposing to end the 6x1 work schedule and reduce working hours.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Senate President Davi Alcolumbre has scheduled the floor debate for next Tuesday (6) on the Constitutional Amendment Proposal (PEC) that addresses ending the 6x1 work schedule and reducing working hours.

With the date set, the proposal will undergo a second vote, allowing senators to debate and decide on whether to maintain or alter the measure establishing the 6x1 schedule and employees' working hours.

According to the text of the bill, the PEC aims to end the practice of the 6x1 work schedule and promote a reduction in working hours, a topic that has been widely discussed in legislative bodies.

With information from Agência Brasil.
